title: +FRAMING YOUR CAREER PLAN
description: Develop career-based skills and gain knowledge on how to communicate one's value in the workplace. Explore effective job search strategies and design a personalized professional growth plan.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: BA 160, 160H or DSGN 253.
A minimum grade of C- is required in BA 160, BA 160H and DSGN 253.

Students with a term class standing of Freshman may not enroll.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in:

  • Apparel Design (400)
  • Pre-Apparel (453)
  • Pre-Interiors (454)
  • Interior Design (458)
  • Design & Innovation Management (912)
  • Product and Merchandising Mgmt (A014)
attribute_description: Core Education - Beyond OSU II, Career Engagement (CSC2)
meeting_html: M 4pm-4:50pm in AUST 183 - Austin Hall 183 (9/23 to 12/4)
